title: The Ultimate Disneyland Adventure: 4 days of magic across both parks for your crew of 3–4
description: Four days at the Happiest Place on Earth — strategically planned so you hit every headliner ride, savour the best food in both parks, and still have time to soak in the atmosphere. This itinerary covers Disneyland Park and Disney California Adventure with a smart park-hopper flow, evening spectaculars, and insider tips that'll save you hours in line.

days.neighborhoods: Disneyland Park — Adventureland · New Orleans Square · Frontierland · Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge
days.title: Disneyland Park — Classics & Galaxy's Edge
days.description: Start your trip at the original Disneyland Park. Hit the west side first — the iconic dark rides, Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge, and the timeless attractions that Walt himself built. End the night with Fantasmic!

activities.name: Rope Drop → Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge
activities.description: Arrive early and head straight to Galaxy's Edge. Ride Rise of the Resistance first — it's the crown jewel of Disney rides, an immersive 18-minute experience that puts you in a Star Wars battle. Then hit Smugglers Run while the land is still quiet. Head to Adventureland for Indiana Jones — a thrilling jeep ride through a cursed temple. Lines build fast, so ride before 10am.

activities.name: New Orleans Square & Frontierland
activities.description: Explore the charm of New Orleans Square — ride Pirates of the Caribbean and Haunted Mansion, two of Disney's greatest dark rides. Then head to Frontierland for Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, the wildest ride in the wilderness.

activities.name: Oga's Cantina
activities.description: Head back to Galaxy's Edge for craft cocktails (and mocktails) in the most immersive bar Disney has ever built. DJ R-3X spins tunes, animatronic creatures lurk in corners, and the drinks are wildly creative. End the night with Fantasmic! on the Rivers of America — a spectacular water, fire, and projection show featuring Mickey battling Disney villains. Arrive 30-45 min early for a good spot.

days.neighborhoods: Disney California Adventure — Cars Land · Avengers Campus · Pixar Pier · Grizzly Peak
days.title: California Adventure — Thrills, Heroes & Sunset
days.description: Today is all about Disney California Adventure. From the neon glow of Cars Land to the superhero action of Avengers Campus, this park packs incredible rides, excellent food, and the stunning World of Color nighttime show.

activities.name: Rope Drop → Radiator Springs Racers
activities.description: Head straight to Cars Land and ride Radiator Springs Racers — a slot-car race through the stunning desert canyons of Radiator Springs. This ride consistently has 60-90 min waits, but at rope drop you can walk on in 15 minutes. Web Slingers: A Spider-Man Adventure is a fun interactive shooter ride. Watch for live superhero encounters — Spider-Man does real stunts on the rooftops and characters roam the campus throughout the day.

activities.name: Pixar Pier & Grizzly Peak
activities.description: Ride the Incredicoaster (a full-loop launch coaster along the boardwalk), explore Pixar Pier's carnival games, and cool off on Grizzly River Run — you WILL get soaked.

activities.name: Cars Land at Night
activities.description: Return to Cars Land after dark — the neon signs light up and the entire land transforms into a glowing Route 66 dreamscape. It's one of the most magical sights at any Disney park. Ride Radiator Springs Racers again at night for a completely different experience. Disney California Adventure's signature nighttime show — massive water fountains, projections, fire, and lasers set to Disney music on Paradise Bay. It's emotional, spectacular, and unmissable.

days.neighborhoods: Disneyland Park — Fantasyland · Tomorrowland · Main Street U.S.A. · Toontown
days.title: Disneyland Deep Dive — Fantasyland, Tomorrowland & Fireworks
days.description: Back to Disneyland Park to conquer the east side. Fantasyland's beloved dark rides, Tomorrowland's Space Mountain, Mickey's Toontown, and the grand finale — fireworks over Sleeping Beauty Castle.

activities.name: Rope Drop → Matterhorn & Space Mountain
activities.description: Hit Matterhorn Bobsleds first — it's an icon. Then head to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, the classic indoor roller coaster in pitch darkness. Both have long afternoon waits, so morning is key.

activities.name: Fantasyland & Mickey's Toontown
activities.description: Take in the soul of Disneyland — "it's a small world," Peter Pan's Flight, Mr. Toad's Wild Ride, and the recently reimagined Mickey's Toontown. Peter Pan has notoriously long waits, so use Lightning Lane.

activities.name: Main Street U.S.A. & Castle Fireworks
activities.description: As night falls, stroll down Main Street U.S.A. — the iconic entrance boulevard lit with gas lamps and lined with shops. Then find your spot for the fireworks spectacular over Sleeping Beauty Castle. It's pure Disney magic.

days.neighborhoods: Downtown Disney · Both Parks — Re-rides & Favorites
days.title: Victory Lap — Re-rides, Downtown Disney & Farewell
days.description: Your final day is a flex day — re-ride your favorites, catch anything you missed, explore Downtown Disney's shops and restaurants, and soak in the last drops of magic before heading home.

activities.name: Re-Ride Your Favorites
activities.description: Start the morning re-riding the headliners — Rise of the Resistance, Radiator Springs Racers, or whichever rides your group loved most. Morning lines are shorter, and second rides often reveal details you missed.

activities.name: Downtown Disney District
activities.description: Step outside the parks to Downtown Disney — a free-entry shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Browse the massive World of Disney store, check out LEGO Store builds, and grab some last souvenirs. Head back into the parks for anything left on your list. Jungle Cruise in Disneyland, Guardians of the Galaxy – Mission: BREAKOUT! in DCA, or a second round of Oga's Cantina.

activities.name: One Last Walk Down Main Street
activities.description: Before you leave, take one final stroll down Main Street U.S.A. toward the castle. Look back from the entrance — Sleeping Beauty Castle framed by the gas lamps and turrets — and take your farewell photo. You'll be back.
